text:
Noel (AE): Heads-up — QuestCare POC moving to procurement. They want invoices split across QuestCare US / QuestCare EU (IE) / QuestCare Labs UK, each with its own PO and signer. Attached is a DPA redline asking for HSM in hosted env and 48h incident notice. Can we do multi-entity billing + AP signer delegation?

procurement_questcare: Hi team — AP can sign. Need separate PDF invoices, VAT handling for EU, and an HSM clause. Also ask that each PO map to the correct remit address.

Priya (Legal): AP delegation OK with a simple attestation (name, title, email, statement of authority). HSM-for-hosted is a product escalation; standard: HSM available for Private/Dedicated only. For Hosted we offer KMS attestation + SOC2/pen-test. 48h notice is tight; we'll propose reasonable efforts with confirmation within 72h after validation. Also counter their 30-day deletion demand with 90-day retention + documented purge.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Tech can tag OF with billing_entity, po_number, signer_email, and remit_id. We'll route invoices and create separate PDF per entity. Example OF fragment: billing_entity: quest-eu-ie, po_number: QC-EU-204, signer: "AP Team <ap@questcare.ie>". Fallback: parent-finance alias if unmapped.

Asha (Finance): Separate invoices and tax IDs required before first invoice. For EU reverse-charge we need validated VAT numbers. Net terms: procurement requested net30; finance can approve after credit check. If credit fails, prepay or CC on file for POC. Separate billing accounts will be created in AR for each legal entity.

Tom (Security): HSM note: Hosted customers get attestable KMS only. Private/Dedicated supports HSM custody. We'll provide KMS architecture and recent pen-test summary to procurement. Also confirm: hosted does not support key export.

Noel (AE): Great — procurement, please upload redlines, remit addresses, and AP attestation. We'll route to Legal/Finance once posted.

procurement_questcare: Will post redline and tax IDs today. One Q: liability cap — they propose 12 months fees. Is Redwood okay with a floor?

Priya (Legal): We'll counter with cap = fees paid in prior 12 months or $250k floor, whichever is greater. Drafting attestation clause and HSM/KMS language now.

Noel (AE): Thanks team — I’ll follow up and post documents.
